VIS-4/7badbc4602dde230.rationale: Summary of the owner/agent split, detailed in the following arms.

VIS-4/6e17891f5ee99a50.rationale: Introduces the four separate owner-only arms.

VIS-4/384a3604b3dc5d69.rationale: Repository governance ownership subdivides beyond this POC; the write guard does not prove clause-wide enforcement.

VIS-4/802e934b41bee7c9.scope: Weakening detection or fail-closed screening, disclosing a secret, or allowing outside-sandbox execution is owner-only.
VIS-4/802e934b41bee7c9.rationale: Materialize and the observer authority describe narrower effects than this class.

VIS-4/7c5e282e4fa7e178.scope: Writing to repositories outside the owner's list or changing that list is owner-only.
VIS-4/7c5e282e4fa7e178.rationale: The specific Butlers foreclosure proves neither list enforcement nor all external writes.

VIS-4/eae64ec8c8aedfda.scope: Public exposure beyond the tailnet, release, deployment and multi-user use are owner-only.
VIS-4/eae64ec8c8aedfda.rationale: The route declarations carry client classes but do not prove network exposure or release governance.

VIS-4/7bbb8d7318346c32.rationale: Scope of agent decisions within accepted screening, send and sandbox rules.

VIS-4/c305bc6692580e44.scope: An adoption must land with one append-only row, a revert and a tag for a spec version; report the row.
VIS-4/c305bc6692580e44.rationale: No single POC adapter refusal proves recording and reporting discipline.

VIS-4/5adf209f1ea8a2ae.scope: A veto requires reverting and recording it; readoption requires the owner.
VIS-4/5adf209f1ea8a2ae.rationale: The veto is a governing decision path, with no whole-arm typed denial evidenced here.

VIS-4/551c6a1ecf9efc96.scope: Treat uncertainty about owner-class status as owner-class and ask.
VIS-4/551c6a1ecf9efc96.rationale: The classification judgment has no typed refusal evidenced in the scoped declarations.

VIS-4/cde8eda8cd5c6dac.rationale: Defines how the owner's words and the applying commit are recorded.

VIS-4/ca02f01ad0ba1a82.scope: Agent adoption satisfies lower agent-class asks; reads and declared-provider sends need no separate per-repository record.
VIS-4/ca02f01ad0ba1a82.rationale: The precedence rule covers workflow and admission seams beyond the declared POC effects.

VIS-4/89c30d518873f062.scope: An agent-class gate cannot be held as an owner gate under the retired regime.
VIS-4/89c30d518873f062.rationale: Tracker and governance policy, with no exact typed refusal in this register's evidence.

VIS-4/db4ccb1499415693.rationale: Violation examples for owner classes, adoption, spec divergence reporting and veto.

VIS-5/869b0eb311b86190.rationale: Summary of direct-write and implementation boundaries detailed below.

VIS-5/e3c03e47b45dc6a3.rationale: Introduces the exact two direct content namespaces.

VIS-5/fb0f635ca2068958.scope: Direct OpenSpec writes stay in the named root and follow its schema and architecture.
VIS-5/fb0f635ca2068958.rationale: The selected typed write guard is specific to Materialize and does not prove direct-content write scope.

VIS-5/ae8b9de5cfd4eed0.scope: Direct native governance writes stay in the named root and its schema-versioned forms.
VIS-5/ae8b9de5cfd4eed0.rationale: The selected typed write guard does not enumerate native governance writes.

VIS-5/afc9828a9d667493.scope: No manifest, configuration or convention may widen these two direct-write roots.
VIS-5/afc9828a9d667493.rationale: This is a global scope rule, with no complete typed denial witnessed in this POC cohort.

VIS-5/332cd0489daedb7a.scope: Declared sources may be read throughout the project. Direct create, modify, move and deletion outside the two roots are prohibited.
VIS-5/332cd0489daedb7a.rationale: The observer's Git-read scope and Materialize denial are narrower recorded evidence.

VIS-5/9768f5f3aeaf2f0a.scope: Outside the direct roots, effects require explicitly authorized typed adapters under their respective authority contracts.
VIS-5/9768f5f3aeaf2f0a.rationale: No single effect guard is evidence for every adapter and store.

VIS-5/a3c9bdc182831bb0.scope: Syzygy may create governed proposals but never materialize the form or function of implementation code.
VIS-5/a3c9bdc182831bb0.rationale: The Beads-specific foreclosure does not prove this general implementation boundary.

VIS-5/162b9520fc20d61d.rationale: Names the permitted governed proposal artifact and commit-out lane.

VIS-5/9dec629e313ae95d.scope: Generated contents cannot be applied, committed or merged as implementation by Syzygy.
VIS-5/9dec629e313ae95d.rationale: No scoped observe/serve/Materialize outcome tests this entire boundary.

VIS-5/546b490efa261cef.rationale: Explains the actor boundary while retaining VIS-4 human controls.

VIS-5/1daa58621bf285ff.rationale: Violation examples for the direct roots, implementation and adapter rules.

SEC-1/ce299a3d3246622c.scope: Only loopback may serve without authentication, and location alone never establishes identity.
SEC-1/ce299a3d3246622c.rationale: Client classes in route declarations do not prove host-wide ingress and identity behavior.

SEC-1/3f3ea56fd3da4bc5.rationale: Introduces separate browser and machine client boundaries.

SEC-1/fd951743f0caa38c.scope: Browser origin and CSRF protection apply even on loopback, including localhost and DNS-rebinding attacks.
SEC-1/fd951743f0caa38c.rationale: A local caller has a typed guard; this register does not witness the full origin and CSRF arm across all served routes.

SEC-1/b9a0e69d7d75bf12.scope: Non-browser agents and CLI clients require explicit machine authentication.
SEC-1/b9a0e69d7d75bf12.rationale: Machine credential classes are declared here; whole-arm authentication refusal is beyond these declaration witnesses.

SEC-1/407bec789c9c342c.scope: Do not infer authentic identity merely from loopback location.
SEC-1/407bec789c9c342c.rationale: A scope and identity boundary, wider than a single credential class or HTTP branch.

SEC-1/f52c9c1656c3f4df.scope: Missing browser Origin grants neither automatic trust nor automatic violation.
SEC-1/f52c9c1656c3f4df.rationale: The complete negative and legitimate non-browser controls are outside the selected effect evidence.

SEC-1/808272af80c3fb46.scope: Non-localhost access requires authenticated TLS inside the owner's tailnet and is not default unauthenticated access.
SEC-1/808272af80c3fb46.rationale: The route source does not make a claim about the actual ingress topology.

SEC-1/d9a26341910a7541.scope: Public ingress, release, deployment and multi-user operation require the owner's decision.
SEC-1/d9a26341910a7541.rationale: Current mounted paths do not carry a release or public ingress authorization.

SEC-1/adbd1b103575b0fd.rationale: Examples of violations of the loopback, CSRF, machine-auth and public scope arms.

SEC-2/054d2d3f082e8574.scope: Data and derivatives may reach a non-owner-controlled service only as a declared provider. Preserve the D11 exception and no per-repository consent rule.
SEC-2/054d2d3f082e8574.rationale: The observer registry declares read scope, with no full run-wide egress enforcement witness.

SEC-2/09d1f21b0471c207.rationale: Defines the covered data and derived content, including public/private prompts.

SEC-2/8f6bb9ad75b6a63d.scope: The run declares its providers and the surface renders them.
SEC-2/8f6bb9ad75b6a63d.rationale: The selected routes do not establish run-wide provider disclosure.

SEC-2/524b5e2985826be9.rationale: No exact provider egress refusal is witnessed by this POC scope.

SEC-2/880b9ab001932a86.scope: Syzygy sends neither secret-matching nor unclassifiable bytes through any request, brief or egress path.
SEC-2/880b9ab001932a86.rationale: No run-wide classification/send witness is in this register.

SEC-2/7e75d5e5c598b5f9.scope: D11 admits the dossier authoring session's own raw clone reads with the listed conditions. Every other session and feature stays outside the exception, and writeback still meets SEC-5.
SEC-2/7e75d5e5c598b5f9.rationale: This is an explicitly bounded exception, with no whole-arm observer/Materialize witness.

SEC-2/c91bcbc68b758de1.scope: The raw-read exception still requires the provider declared for the run.
SEC-2/c91bcbc68b758de1.rationale: The observer's effect declaration is not an author-session admission check.

SEC-2/cd288ee03f604174.scope: Record the unscreened raw-read and secret-risk disclosure on every run, at each spec-defined location, including a run with no rendered page.
SEC-2/cd288ee03f604174.rationale: No dossier session records or outputs are examined by this check.

SEC-2/6ff7f99a5cebc8dd.scope: With no declared provider, inferred work remains Unknown without computation.
SEC-2/6ff7f99a5cebc8dd.rationale: This register does not verify the inferred layer's provider selection behavior.

SEC-2/e291d83b8f6f74bf.scope: Non-owner-controlled backing services require the same provider declaration.
SEC-2/e291d83b8f6f74bf.rationale: No backing service effect is claimed from these POC inputs.

SEC-2/4974c59bf37c804e.rationale: Records the owner's explicit read/send trade-off.

SEC-2/ca39d904442c0137.rationale: Contrasting violation examples for undeclared providers, egress and raw author reads.

SEC-3/b93e22d085e47f9e.scope: Observed projects are untrusted. Syzygy cannot run their code, and outside-sandbox agent execution is owner-class.
SEC-3/b93e22d085e47f9e.rationale: A false observer registry flag is declaration evidence rather than an executable refusal for the full policy.

SEC-3/c5f4a9b8fff69cb5.rationale: The untrusted classification does not depend on repository ownership.

SEC-3/31576b5846838258.scope: No daemon or other Syzygy process executes observed project code.
SEC-3/31576b5846838258.rationale: The scoped adapter flag does not establish the behavior of every process.

SEC-3/bdcad337cba7ee20.rationale: Defines the process and instruction population to which SEC-3 applies.

SEC-3/e2b9701d448d019f.scope: Sandbox execution requires default deny, isolated credentials, declared network, resource/destructive limits and a recorded agent decision before instruction.
SEC-3/e2b9701d448d019f.rationale: The selected POC routes do not attest sandbox isolation or its instruction boundary.

SEC-3/b46dab1f88a6ca5b.scope: Outside a profile, require prior scoped owner authority on the owner's host and an attended owner-started session. Only owned-list repos may have a withdrawal-sensitive standing choice. No launched/unattended session or outliving process is covered.
SEC-3/b46dab1f88a6ca5b.rationale: Neither the registry flag nor the write refusal witnesses this permitted execution path.

SEC-3/f9ee359545af7509.rationale: Describes the risk and accepted costs of the exception.

SEC-3/5d9baea48e5f2946.scope: Execution-derived claims are Inferred with command disclosures, and typed-adapter credentials remain OS-isolated from the session and its processes.
SEC-3/5d9baea48e5f2946.rationale: The register observes no actual execution or credential material.

SEC-3/74e11dd6337d4125.rationale: Records the owner trade-off for sandboxed agent work.

SEC-3/11aeb33b6f4a9069.rationale: Violation examples reinforce isolation, attendance, authority and epistemic classification.

SEC-4/a8be5f2ac45ba099.rationale: Summary of the write and consent rules, represented by the following distinct arms.

SEC-4/81eb1a01780687d1.scope: A write or push to a repository outside the owner's registered list requires recorded consent for that repository.
SEC-4/81eb1a01780687d1.rationale: The P-71-Q5 typed refusal proves the named case, without establishing a universal consent gate.

SEC-4/5319ec96ea7927ae.scope: Only the owner changes the owned repository list. An unlisted repository counts as foreign.
SEC-4/5319ec96ea7927ae.rationale: No owner-list writer or validation case is part of the declared POC effects.

SEC-4/a8f7b25132551afc.scope: Every write is attributed, atomic and individually revertable.
SEC-4/a8f7b25132551afc.rationale: A foreclosed write never exercises the actual feasibility of these positive obligations.

SEC-4/3951595a6f0080b8.scope: Show a conflict before overwriting governance material that Syzygy did not author.
SEC-4/3951595a6f0080b8.rationale: The Materialize runner does not adjudicate governance artifact conflicts.

SEC-4/d664533dad8c8855.rationale: Examples restate the foreign-write, owned-list and overwrite boundaries.

SEC-5/da23d89d78c0d926.rationale: States the general secret exclusion rule, separated below into distinct typed-policy boundaries.

SEC-5/f730c8f1fc2babcc.scope: The recorded policy is applied during observation.
SEC-5/f730c8f1fc2babcc.rationale: No full classifier execution and exact policy trace is asserted by this evidence register.

SEC-5/900487ebfc35668d.scope: Detecting less, admitting unclassifiable content or exposing a secret requires the owner. Other screening changes are agent adoptions.
SEC-5/900487ebfc35668d.rationale: This register cannot grant or adjudicate a screening change.

SEC-5/c2abe134f7392b4c.scope: D11 admits only the disclosed raw reads of the dossier authoring session. Other weakening remains owner-class.
SEC-5/c2abe134f7392b4c.rationale: The observer register does not prove authoring-session exceptions.

SEC-5/3e0e29e449c26c12.scope: Exclude matching content and make the exclusion visible.
SEC-5/3e0e29e449c26c12.rationale: No typed claim is made across the full index, render and send pipeline.

SEC-5/1d98150bd7a77b88.scope: Exclude unclassifiable content. Classification fails closed.
SEC-5/1d98150bd7a77b88.rationale: This register does not execute a source reader or a classifier.

SEC-5/ab2cbeeaef981677.scope: A secret appearing in any surface, store or endpoint breaks the trust floor.
SEC-5/ab2cbeeaef981677.rationale: The register processes only scoped repository-authored declarations and contains no underlying observed payload.

SEC-5/ed1b48311f238a64.rationale: Example of a SEC-5 violation in served output.

P-71-Q5/1ca2cf1f3efff7aa.scope: Butlers tracker return write is foreclosed. A future run requires a dated owner act, then a scoped registry amendment, then fresh implementation authority.
